description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff development within a supportive environment. If you are passionate about clinical excellence and team leadership, we encourage you to apply.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in overseeing nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and supporting the Director of Nursing. This position is ideal for a Registered Nurse (RN) looking to advance their career in a dynamic healthcare setting. We are offering a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment.

Join a team that values your contributions and provides a platform for professional growth. This is an urgent opening, and we are actively seeking qualified candidates to fill this vital position.
requirements: Minimum of 2 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing facility
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000 based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This vital role involves coordinating and completing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, ensuring accurate and timely submission, and contributing to comprehensive care planning for our residents. We are looking for a professional who is passionate about resident care and compliance.The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of MDS 3.0 guidelines and a commitment to maintaining high standards of documentation. This position offers a competitive hourly rate of $32-$36 per hour, reflecting your expertise and dedication. If you are an RN with a keen eye for detail and a desire to make a significant impact on resident outcomes, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
In-depth knowledge of MDS 3.0 and associated regulations
Strong assessment, documentation, and communication skills
Ability to collaborate effectively with interdisciplinary teams
